blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A 42-year-old driver and his 11-month-old child died after a dump truck crashed onto their motorcycle on Tuesday morning, Oct. 27, the Quezon City Police District (QCPD) confirmed. Based on initial investigations, a dump truck was travelling along Congressional Avenue toward Luzon Avenue in Quezon City when it tipped over onto the victim’s motorcycle at around 12:30 a.m. The 29-year-old driver, alias ‘Randel’, reportedly lost control of his vehicle.
